app.name: Polkadot.js Apps
app.description: Developer interface for inspecting chain state and composing transactions on supported Substrate networks.

reviewMethod: Agent review of official product documentation and production network configuration; maintainer-authorized publication through tested main
notes: Official production endpoint groups separately list Polkadot Relay, Kusama Relay, both Asset Hubs, Hydration, Astar and each Bifrost parachain. A developer interface, not a recommendation to manage wallet secrets. Listed networks are the verified subset in this directory, not an exhaustive product support list. No funded transaction or security audit was performed.
